Facility Inventory & Condition Assessmen.justification: Comprehensive district-wide inventory including detailed data on classrooms, specialized spaces, and site acreage; robust condition assessment covering HVAC, roofing, lighting, plumbing, technology infrastructure, and accessibility; connects condition data to student outcomes and long-term capital planning (Sections 3.1, 4.1).

Enrollment & Capacity Planning.justification: Detailed enrollment projections over 7+ years with demographic and housing development data; site-level capacity utilization including permanent and relocatable classrooms; explicit connection of enrollment projections to facility actions including new construction and replacement of relocatables (Sections 2.3, 2.4, 2.5, 4.1).

Educational Alignment.justification: Educational alignment is a core organizing principle with detailed educational specifications and 21st century standards; clear integration of district mission, instructional priorities, and facilities planning; facility projects directly respond to educational goals including STEM, special education, and technology integration (Sections 1.4, 1.5, 1.6, 4.1).

Outdoor Spaces & Greening.justification: Provides data and analysis of outdoor spaces including playfields, hard courts, and playgrounds; identifies strategies for improvements such as synthetic turf, shade structures, and playground upgrades; references site-specific greening and play area conditions but lacks districtwide greening data or climate resilience framing (Sections 3.1, 4.1).

Climate Risk & Mitigation.justification: Acknowledges climate-related facility impacts indirectly through energy efficiency and HVAC upgrades; no comprehensive climate risk assessment or multi-hazard analysis; climate readiness is a consideration but not a central theme in assessment or planning (Sections 3.1, 4.1, 5.1).

Energy Efficiency & Resilience.justification: District-wide solar panel installations at all schools; ongoing Proposition 39 funded energy efficiency upgrades including LED lighting and HVAC improvements; references Title 24 and state goals; energy resilience discussed but without comprehensive strategies such as microgrids or battery storage (Sections 3.1, 4.1, 5.1).

Financial Plan & Capital Strategy.justification: Comprehensive capital strategy with detailed cost estimates, phased project prioritization, and multiple funding sources including State grants, GO bonds, CFDs, and developer fees; includes escalation assumptions, contingencies, and long-term financial sustainability considerations; clear alignment of financial capacity with district priorities (Sections 5, 6).
